purpose: Provide an executable fixture-local pure query for supplied uniform gravity, air-mass velocity, density and speed of sound, with direct air-data and rigid-core consumer links.

provenance.notes: The Scientific Authority accepted supplied position- and time-invariant fields for this fixture-local scope. Legacy altitude decay appears only as rejected behavior; the bundle has no product or Legacy runtime dependency.

expected_facts.claim: Independent 80-digit Decimal and C++17 implementations return the supplied inertial gravity, air-mass velocity, density and speed of sound for every valid query position and tick.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Model, frame, clock, tick, revision and quality identities are exact; finite physical values use the fixture-local absolute-plus-relative tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: The response feeds the accepted air-data formulas and rigid-core translational formula at the same sample identity, including valid zero density and sub-one speed of sound.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Consumer frame/time/revision identities are exact; relative velocity, speed, dynamic pressure, Mach and acceleration use the fixture-local formula tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: The executable preserves physical values across position/tick changes, rejects incompatible identity and invalid numeric domains, and detects Legacy-style altitude density and gravity decay.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Equivalence, rejection and mutation dispositions are exact; no tolerance repairs an invalid query or definition.

acceptance: The bundle records explicit model/query identities, every supplied field, direct downstream formula results, invariance and strict failure cases
The Python reference and C++17 probe share no implementation and neither imports product or Legacy code
Earth, altitude models, canonical constants, environment assets and product contracts remain outside this fixture-local slice
